scope: Single and automatic report generation failures

behavior.automatic_batch: Failed report items persist a bounded operation and exception-class summary, print no raw exception, and allow later reports to continue.
behavior.single_report: The CLI prints and raises a bounded RuntimeError without chaining the raw source exception.

coverage: automatic report errors are redacted before durable persistence
automatic batch remains partial and closes its connection
single-report output and raised error omit exception details
existing read-only and CLI preflight contracts remain covered

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked database and report generators

limitations: No report generator, PostgreSQL service, or persisted report batch was run.
This does not establish semantic parity against populated report fixtures.
